title: Photo-Plethysmographic Camera to Monitor Heart Rate, Respiration Rate and Oxygen Saturation in Infants
brief_summary: The researchers want to determine if ambient light, plethysmographic , can monitor reliably heart rate, respiration rate and oxygen saturation in infant patients in a hospital setting.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* infant in NICU at CHOC hospital

Exclusion Criteria:

* non-infant
